cases.title: Companies House registry search to company filing history
cases.task: Load the UK Companies House register, type OPENAI into the search form, open OPENAI UK LTD, and navigate to its filing history so a reporter can inspect downloadable filings.
cases.prompt: Search Companies House for OPENAI, open OPENAI UK LTD company number 14367667, and return evidence from its filing history including company name, company number, filing history, and filing/PDF links.
cases.difficulty: Representative registry workflow: form search, result selection, follow-up navigation, then locating filings or PDFs. A static page snapshot should not score unless it reaches the target evidence.

cases.title: OpenSanctions name screening search
cases.task: Load OpenSanctions, search for a named person, and return the sanctions/PEP evidence for the matching entity.
cases.prompt: Search OpenSanctions for Roman Abramovich, open the matching entity if possible, and return evidence that the result is a person with PEP/sanctions risk and relevant country context.
cases.difficulty: Representative screening workflow: use a search form, land on an entity result, and return risk classifications rather than generic page text.

cases.title: Wikidata entity search for structured company identity
cases.task: Search Wikidata for OpenAI, open the matching entity record, and return structured identity evidence useful for company/person disambiguation.
cases.prompt: Search Wikidata for OpenAI, open Q21708200, and return evidence including the entity label, QID, description, website, and instance/type statements.
cases.difficulty: Structured open-data lookup: form search, result selection, and entity-page evidence rather than a generic search-result snippet.

cases.title: OpenStreetMap place search for a municipality
cases.task: Load OpenStreetMap, search for Zug Switzerland, and return the Nominatim result context and relation links so a reporter can verify the place and map target.
cases.prompt: Search OpenStreetMap for Zug Switzerland and return evidence including the search result label, Nominatim source, map URL or coordinates, and relation links for the state or town.
cases.difficulty: Geographic OSINT lookup: form search, map-result landing state, and source-linked relation evidence from a public open-data site.

cases.title: Wikidata paginated search to the third results page
cases.task: Search Wikidata for Zurich, then paginate twice to reach the third page of search results and preserve the results-count evidence.
cases.prompt: Search Wikidata for Zurich, navigate to the third page of search results, and return the visible evidence including the results-count line and result entries.
cases.difficulty: Multi-page pagination workflow (approved by Tom 2026-07-03 to break the zero-signal tie): the dominant probe is the 'Results 41 - 60' count line, which only exists on the third page - a tool that stops on page 1 scores at most 0.4. Live-validated: page 1 exposes only the offset=20 pager link; offset=40 appears on page 2.
